problem: Windows DirEntry.stat returns zero file IDs, causing unrelated files to collapse into one deduplicated audit size.
invariant: Read volume/file identity through os.stat with follow_symlinks=False; prove distinct files stay distinct and hardlinks share identity. Logical byte totals never authorize deletion or claim physical disk allocation.
failure_behavior: Keep unreadable paths unexamined and retain scan errors; never classify source files as deletable from inventory size alone.
